claims.title: One-pulse 3D energy-ball performance for every admitted weak solution

quoted_fields.interface: Native prescribed skew-transport equation u_t=nu*Delta u-P div(u tensor u)+P[(b.grad)u] on unit T3, with mean-zero divergence-free Leray-Hopf solutions. NO stretching term P[(u.grad)b]. Fixed center amplitude a=.01, nu=.001; b=f(t)*theta*(e2+e)*sin(2pi*x1+phi), e.e1=0, |e|<=1/1024, |theta-1|<=1/1024, ARBITRARY static phi. Quintic smoothstep ramps.1/plateau4/reverse ramp.1, zero after4.2; no feedback or intermediate reset. No timing/drifting/frequency-error extension is imported. Initial data have only the stated FULL3D L2-ball condition, with no H3, symmetry or finite-Fourier restriction. Relative-energy comparison uses the smooth 2D3C vertical center.
